call.speech.wait_one_more.note: Fixed per back-translation note. needs_fix: 'Ja, és még egy kérdésem lenne' means 'Oh, and I'd have one more question' and lost 'wait'. This line stops the caller from hanging up, so it should mean 'Oh, wait, I have one more question', e.g. 'Ja, várjon, még egy kérdésem lenne.'

call.speech.no_wait.back: "one moment", "wait" (informal), "wait" (polite), "one second", "wait a little" (informal), "I'll look", "I'll look into it", "I'm checking now"
call.speech.no_wait.note: Fixed per back-translation note. needs_fix: only polite (ön) forms plus 'megnézem', but call.json allows te or ön, so te forms are not caught. Meaning should be: banned stalling phrases in both forms; add 'várj', 'várjon', 'egy másodperc', 'egy kicsit várj'. | Translator note: List of banned stalling phrases, Hungarian.

call.speech.unavailable.back: The number called is currently unavailable. Please try again later.

call.speech.preview.back: Hello? / Ah, a package? Of course, just leave it in front of the door, thank you very much. / All right, goodbye.

call.speech.closing.back: Farewells: goodbye, goodbye (on the phone), bye, all the best, have a nice day, have a further nice day, good night. Wrap-ups: that's it then, I won't keep you any longer, I have to hang up now, I'll call back later. Ends: Thank you very much for your help, goodbye. / All right, that's it then, all the best. / I've written everything down, thank you, have a nice day. Not ends: Good day to you, I'd like to ask about tomorrow's delivery. / The courier didn't say goodbye, so I'm calling customer service. / I won't keep you longer than a minute, we just check the data. / I wish my colleagues all the best, now let's look at the points of the contract.
call.speech.closing.note: AI check: not_ends #1 ('Jó napot kívánok, ...') has no farewell word, so it does not test the rule; the other three do. | Translator note: Farewells and examples need a native check before verified can be true.

Chat commands (Slack only): switch on Socket Mode, then specify the bot's token (xoxb-), the app-level token (xapp-) and the channel identifier.

console.hint_line.back: LINE Developers console → Messaging API channel: create a channel access token, and copy your user identifier (it starts with the letter U). First add the bot as a friend. LINE Notify ceased in 2025; this replaces it.

console.hint_ntfy.back: Choose a topic name that is hard to guess, and subscribe to it in the ntfy app. To use ntfy.sh, leave the server empty. A token is only needed for protected topics.

console.hint_gotify.back: In Gotify: Apps → Create application, then copy the token. The server URL is the address of your Gotify server.

console.hint_bark.back: Open the Bark app on your iPhone, and copy the device key from the sample URL. For the public server, leave the server empty.

console.hint_pushover.back: Create an application on the pushover.net site for the API token. The user key is found on the Pushover dashboard.

console.hint_wecom.back: In the WeCom group: add a group bot, then copy its webhook URL.

console.hint_dingtalk.back: Group settings → Bots → adding a custom bot, then copy the webhook URL. If you chose the signature (“Sign”) as the security setting, paste the secret key (it starts with SEC).

console.hint_feishu.back: Group settings → Bots → Add bot → Custom bot, then copy the webhook URL. Do not switch on signature verification.

console.hint_serverchan.back: Copy the SendKey from the ServerChan website.

console.hint_matrix.back: The address of the homeserver (e.g. https://matrix.org), the access token of the sending account, and the identifier of a room that the account has joined (it starts with !).

console.hint_gmail.back: Your Gmail address and an app password (Google account → Security → Two-step verification → App passwords). Not your usual password.

console.hint_apprise.back: The notification URL of the Apprise API server, e.g. http://host:8000/notify/KEY. With a tag it can be narrowed which services receive the message.

console.hint_webhook.back: Any URL that receives a JSON POST request with event, title, body and data fields. Useful for n8n, Home Assistant or your own scripts.

console.hint_teams.back: In Teams: the channel's … menu → Workflows → “Publishing in a channel when a webhook request arrives”, finish the steps and copy the URL you received. The old Office 365 connectors have ceased.

console.hint_googlechat.back: In Google Chat: open the space → Apps and integrations → Webhooks → Add webhook, then copy the URL. A Google Workspace account is required.
console.hint_googlechat.note: fixed: space is just a space

console.hint_rocketchat.back: Administration → Workspace → Integrations → New → Incoming: switch it on, select the channel, and copy the webhook URL.

console.hint_zulip.back: Personal settings → Bots → Add new bot (Incoming webhook or Generic), then enter the e-mail address and the API key in email:key format. Target: channel > topic (e.g. calls > phone), or one or more e-mail addresses for a direct message.

console.hint_webex.back: Create a bot on the developer.webex.com site, and copy its access token. Add the bot to a space, and enter the room identifier or the e-mail address of a person.

console.hint_nextcloud.back: The address of Nextcloud, the user name and an app password (Settings → Security) in user:password format, as well as the token of the conversation (the last part of the conversation's link).

console.hint_synology.back: In Synology Chat: Integration → Incoming webhooks → Creating, then copy the webhook URL. On your own network the http:// address on port 5000 avoids certificate errors.

console.hint_signal.back: Your own signal-cli-rest-api server with a registered number is required. Enter the address of the server, the registered number in international format (+…) and the recipients: numbers or group identifiers separated by commas.

console.hint_pushbullet.back: pushbullet.com → Settings → Account → Create Access Token. Leave the target empty if you want to send to all your devices, or enter a device identifier or e-mail address.

console.hint_pushplus.back: Log in on the pushplus.plus site and copy your token. With a group code it sends to the given group; left empty only to you.

console.hint_pushdeer.back: Open the PushDeer application, add a key and copy it. For the public server leave the server empty.

console.hint_wxpusher.back: Simplest: a simple push token (SPT_…) from the WxPusher website, without a target. Or the application's appToken (AT_…) with user (UID_…) or topic identifiers, separated by commas.

console.hint_chanify.back: In the Chanify application create a token for this sender and copy it. For the public server leave the server empty.

console.hint_smtp.back: Any mail server supporting TLS: smtp://you@example.com@smtp.example.com:587 (STARTTLS) or smtps://…:465. The login name is also the sender. Use an app password if the provider supports it.

console.hint_homeassistant.back: The address of Home Assistant, a long-lived access token (Profile → Security) and the notification service, e.g. mobile_app_pixel_9 (found under Developer tools → Actions).

console.hint_ifttt.back: On the ifttt.com/maker_webhooks → Documentation page your key can be seen. Create an “If Webhooks: Receive a web request” applet with the same event name; value1 is the title, value2 is the message.

console.f_public_url_h.back: The links in notifications use this address. Empty = the address shown in grey; with Docker, or if you also want to reach it from outside your home, type your own.

console.use_this_url.back: Using the address of the current page: {url}

console.g_summary_d.back: After every call the AI writes a short summary. Here usually nothing needs to be set.

console.f_sum_base_h.back: Any OpenAI-compatible service works, e.g. https://api.openai.com/v1.

console.f_sum_provider_h.back: By default it uses your Gemini key. For another service choose the “Another service” option.

console.f_cal_suggest_h.back: If a time is arranged in a call (delivery, meeting), the summary contains an “add to the calendar” link.

console.f_appt_mode_h.back: If the caller wants to arrange a time, the AI does not agree immediately, but promises feedback. After that you can press the Accept or the Decline button in the “To do” section of the Calls page or in the notification.

console.f_appt_sms_h.back: After you have decided, the phone that took the call sends an SMS to the caller (only to mobile numbers). Off: the AI rather calls them back.

console.f_appt_reply_h.back: Automatic: SMS to a mobile number, AI return call to a landline. Hidden numbers and numbers that cannot be called back (foreign, toll-free, etc.) do not receive a reply.

console.f_think_h.back: Only for models that contain the word “thinking” in their name. Low answers the fastest.

console.ph_none.back: Connect the phone with a USB data cable, switch on USB debugging, and open the application.

console.ph_unauth.back: Waiting for permission: unlock the phone and accept the “Do you allow USB debugging?” request.

console.ph_offline.back: Offline: pull out the cable, then plug it in again.

console.ph_noapp.back: The Bageo application is not installed on this phone.

console.ph_link_ok.back: The USB connection is alive, the application is installed

console.ph_link_bad.back: The USB connection has not been established yet. Wait a few seconds.

console.usb_off.back: The USB helper is switched off

console.usb_off_d.back: The phones connect to the Bageo program over the network.

console.usb_noadb_d.back: The phones on USB cannot be set up automatically. Install the Android platform-tools package, or set the ADB_BIN variable.

console.usb_none.back: No phone can be found on USB

console.chk_key_bad.back: Enter the key so that the AI can speak.

console.chk_owner_bad.back: Tell the AI how callers address you.

console.chk_prompt_bad.back: Answer a few questions in the “About you” section so that the AI resembles you more.

console.chk_phone_bad.back: Currently no phone is connected. See the “Phones” section on this page.

console.chk_notify_bad.back: Add a channel so that you receive the call summaries on your phone.

console.chk_summary_bad.back: A Gemini key or another summary service is needed.

console.chk_ai_off.back: AI call answering is switched off

console.chk_ai_off_bad.back: Switch on: “The AI answers the calls”.

console.chk_all.back: Everything is ready. Call your phone's number to try it out.

console.about.note: fixed: no longer the same word as Contacts

console.ev_hello_reattach.back: The phone reconnected during the call

console.ev_vm_end_max.back: The message reached the time limit

console.ev_vm_end_hangup.back: The caller hung up during leaving a message

console.ev_vm_no_reply.back: The caller does not ask for a reply

console.ev_vm_confirm_timeout.back: No answer to the way of feedback

console.ev_vm_contact_readback_timeout.back: No answer at the reading back of the contact details

console.ev_vm_contact_rejected.back: According to the caller the contact details are wrong

console.ev_vm_reply_contact_confirmed.back: The caller confirmed the contact details

console.ev_vm_reply_phone_confirmed.back: The caller asked for a call back

console.ev_gemini_fail_to_voicemail.back: AI error, redirected to voice message

console.ev_gemini_zero_delivery_to_voice.back: The AI did not send sound, redirected to voice message

console.ev_gemini_delivery_fail_to_voice.back: The AI's sound cannot be played, redirected to voice message

console.ev_call_waiting_rejected.back: It arrived during another call, rejected as busy

console.err_sms_not_retryable.back: This SMS cannot be sent again: no decision has been made yet about the time, or the SMS has already gone.

console.err_no_calendar.back: There is no calendar suggestion for this call.

console.err_no_audio.back: There is no recording of this type for this call.

console.err_open_failed.back: The recording could not be opened.

console.err_unknown_background.back: This background noise is not available.

console.err_background_missing.back: The sound file of the background noise is missing.

console.err_preview_failed.back: The sample could not be prepared. Check the Gemini API key and try again.

console.err_bad_request.back: Bageo did not understand the request.

console.err_save_failed.back: The settings could not be written to disk.

console.err_fulfill_failed.back: The task could not be carried out.

console.err_unknown_channel.back: Bageo does not know this notification service.

console.err_bad_url.back: The “{field}” field must begin with the prefix http:// or https://.

console.err_auth_failed.back: The service rejected the token or the password.

console.err_service_not_found.back: The service does not recognize this address or token.

console.err_http_error.back: The service replied with an error.

console.err_service_error.back: The service reported an error in connection with the message.

console.err_room_encrypted.back: This room is encrypted, and Bageo cannot read encrypted rooms. Use a room without encryption.

console.err_blocked_address.back: Bageo does not send to this address. Enter the notification service's own address.

console.f_mdns_name_h.back: Devices on the same network can reach the web console at http://nev.local. Only letters, numbers and hyphens. Empty = off.
console.f_mdns_name_h.note: fixed: plain letters in the address example

console.cu_qr_h.back: Scan the code with the phone's camera to open the web console.

console.cu_local.back: Only this computer can open this address.

console.cu_qr_alt.back: QR code of the address of the web console

console.a2hs_title.back: Put this page on the home screen. Next time just tap the icon.

console.a2hs_ios.back: iPhone and iPad: Share → Add to Home Screen (Safari).

console.a2hs_android.back: Android: Chrome menu ⋮ → Add to Home screen.

console.a2hs_desktop.back: Computer: the installation icon at the right edge of the address bar (Chrome, Edge).

console.cu_ip.back: Phones that cannot open .local addresses (some older Android devices) use this:

console.ph_mode_normal.back: Normal phone: the calls ring, the AI does not pick up

console.ph_need_update.back: To switch from here, update the Bageo application on this phone

console.ph_to_ai.back: The AI answers the calls again

console.ph_to_normal_b.back: The calls arriving at this phone are not answered by the AI. It rings like a normal phone, and somebody has to pick it up. You can switch back at any time.

console.ph_now_normal.back: From now on it works as a normal phone

console.ph_now_ai.back: The AI answers the calls on this phone again

console.ph_incall_wait.back: In a call: you can switch at the end of the call

console.pm_err_in_call.back: the phone is in a call. Try again at the end of the call

console.pm_err_busy.back: the phone is still finishing the previous switching

console.pm_err_no_root.back: the Bageo module does not run on the phone. Check in the Magisk or KernelSU application whether Bageo Uplink is switched on, then restart the phone

console.pm_err_save_failed.back: the phone could not save the mode

console.pm_err_dialer_failed.back: the phone could not modify the default phone application

console.pm_err_screening_failed.back: the phone could not modify the call-screening setting

console.pm_err_dnd_failed.back: the phone could not modify the Do Not Disturb mode

console.pm_err_volume_failed.back: the phone could not switch the ringtone back on

console.pm_err_invalid_mode.back: the phone did not recognize this mode

console.pm_err_unsupported.back: the application on the phone is too old. Update it first

console.pm_err_timeout.back: The result is not confirmed yet. Refresh the page in a moment.

console.pm_err_failed.back: an error occurred on the phone

console.pm_err_bad_request.back: the request could not be interpreted

console.pill_all_normal.back: All devices are in normal phone mode

console.er_new_d.back: The AI makes the phone call, sorts out the matter, and reports the result. During the call you can read the text, and you can instruct the AI at any time.

console.er_to_ph.back: Type in a name to search, or a phone number

console.er_no_match.back: There is no contact with such a name. You can also type in the phone number.

console.er_need_pick.back: Choose a contact from the list, or type in a phone number.

console.er_task_ph.back:
e.g. Book a table for 4 tomorrow evening at 7 under Kovács, non-smoking; if 7 is full, 7:30–8:00 is fine too
or: Ask whether Saturday or Sunday this weekend suits him for dinner

console.er_task_h.back: Write down what you would like to have sorted out, and what conditions you accept. If the AI is uncertain during the call, it asks you here.

console.er_id_assistant_d.back: The AI says that it phones on your behalf, as an assistant.

console.er_id_owner_d.back: The AI speaks in your name.

console.er_phone_auto.back: Automatic (a free line from which this number can be called)

console.er_phone_normal.back: {name} (normal phone mode, the AI cannot use it)

console.er_phone_h.back: A device in normal phone mode cannot start an AI call. Switch it back on the System page so that the AI answers the calls.

console.er_pre_d.back: Provide them so that the AI does not have to stop and ask during the call.

console.er_pre_sim.back: Using the number of the line

console.er_started.back: Handed over to the AI. It is dialing now.

console.er_queued.back: On the waiting list. The AI calls immediately as soon as a phone becomes free.

console.er_empty_title.back: There is no AI errand yet

console.er_empty_body.back: Write above what needs to be sorted out. The AI telephones, takes action, and tells you the result.

console.er_redial_h.back: If they do not pick up or it is busy, it redials every minute, at most 30 times.

console.er_redial_wait.back: Redialing: attempt no. {n} was not picked up, next call: {time}

console.er_watching.back: You are watching: if the AI is uncertain, it asks you first.

console.er_q_over.back: Time has run out, the AI decides itself

console.er_q_ph.back: Or type in your own answer

console.er_tell_ph.back: e.g. Tell them that 8 o'clock is good too

console.er_hangup_b.back: The AI ends the call immediately. It is possible that the matter has not been sorted out yet.

console.er_unconfirmed.back: The other party did not confirm it

console.er_ans_absent.back: You were not present, no answer

console.er_options.back: The options received. Choose one, and the AI calls them back with this:

console.er_fu_title.back: Reply and a new AI call

console.er_fu_h.back: The AI calls him/her ({who}) again, and replies this.

console.er_delete_t.back: Do you delete this AI errand?

console.er_delete_b.back: It disappears from this list. The call log remains.

console.er_err_no_number.back: Enter the number to be called.

console.er_err_bad_number.back: This number does not seem correct.

console.er_err_not_allowed.back: The AI cannot call this number (emergency, special or premium-rate number).

console.er_err_no_sim_for_country.back: There is no SIM card in any of the phones that could call the numbers of this country.

console.er_err_sim_unknown.back: This phone has not received a call yet, so the system does not know what SIM cards are in it. Call it once, then try again.

console.er_err_no_task.back: Write down what the AI should sort out.

console.er_err_task_too_long.back: Too long: it can be at most 1000 characters.

console.er_err_no_phone.back: Currently there is no available AI phone (it is not connected, or all are in normal phone mode).

console.er_err_not_found.back: This AI errand or contact no longer exists.

console.er_err_busy.back: This call is still on the waiting list or on the line. Try again at the end of the call.

console.er_err_not_on_call.back: The call has ended, so the AI can no longer hand this over.

console.f_er_identity_h.back: Whom the AI claims to be when it telephones instead of you. For the individual errands this can also be changed separately.

console.ct_kind_whitelist.back: White list (family and friends; they can be switched through to you)

console.ct_kind_stall.back: Time-stalling list (the AI drags out their time from the beginning)

console.ct_kind_help.back: How the system should handle the calls arriving from this number.

console.wl_desc.back: Choose who and when can reach you. This does not replace the emergency call services.

console.wl_m_direct.back: Do not pick up: redirect to your phone

console.wl_m_emergency.back: The AI picks up, and in an urgent case it connects you

console.f_wl_num_h.back: The number that the phone calls if something is urgent.

console.f_ui_pw_h.back: If you set it, the web console will ask for it at opening (once per browser). It is necessary if you open the web console on a phone or another computer.

console.pw_setup_title.back: Setting the password of the web console (optional)

console.pw_setup_body.back: Set a password if you also open the web console from outside the home network. You can modify it later in Settings.

console.pw_setup_help.back: This browser remembers it. On a new device you will have to enter it again.

console.pw_setup_short.back: The password must consist of at least 8 characters.

console.n_ctl_users_h_discord.back: In a server channel specify who can give commands, otherwise nobody can. In a private message it can be left empty. Own identifier: switch on Developer Mode, then right-click on your name → Copying User ID.

console.n_ctl_users_h_slack.back: In a channel specify who can give commands, otherwise nobody can. In a direct message it can be left empty. Member identifier: open your profile → ⋮ → Copying member ID.

console.n_ctl_users_h_matrix.back: In a multi-person room specify who can give commands, otherwise nobody can. If only you and the bot are in the room, it can stay empty. A Matrix identifier looks like this: @name:matrix.org.

console.n_ctl_h_slack.back: Querying calls, starting an AI errand and managing to-dos directly from this chat. Send the “@botname /help” message for the commands.

console.n_ctl_h_matrix.back: Querying calls, starting an AI errand and managing to-dos directly from this chat. Send the “@botname /help” message for the commands.

console.ev_whitelist_urgent_call_failed.back: Urgent: it was not possible to reach you

console.ev_whitelist_urgent_call_ai_ende.back: Urgent: the AI left while it was calling you

console.urg_why_ended.back: the call placed to you ended

console.urg_why_merge.back: It was not possible to connect with the caller

console.urg_why_phone.back: the phone could not start the call

console.er_err_empty_text.back: Write down what you would like to say.

console.er_err_question_closed.back: This question has already been answered, or its time has run out.

console.d_del_call_b.back: The summary, the transcript and the recording will be deleted permanently.

console.calls_clear_t.back: Do you delete the entire call log?

console.calls_clear_b.back: Every finished call and recording is deleted permanently. The calls in progress remain.

console.err_call_in_progress.back: Wait for the call to end before the deletion.

console.ph_forget_b.back: It removes this not connected phone from the list. The earlier call logs remain.

console.err_device_in_call.back: Wait until the call ends on this phone.

console.ph_sim_num_ph.back: Enter the number of the SIM

console.bl_voice_link.back: Choosing the voice of the announcement

console.ct_bad_prefix.back: Only a blacklisted number can end with *, and before it at least 3 digits must stand without the leading zeros.

console.sms_empty_d.back: The SMS arriving on the phones appear here as soon as the SMS forwarder runs.

console.sms_pick.back: Choose a conversation, or press the “New message” button.

console.sms_no_line.back: Currently none of the phones can send SMS.

console.sms_no_reply.back: It is not possible to reply to this sender.

console.sms_del_thread_t.back: Do you delete all messages with: {name}?

console.sms_err_old_app.back: The application of the phone is too old for sending SMS.

console.sms_err_permission.back: The application of the phone has no permission to send SMS. Allow it on the phone.

console.sms_err_no_service.back: There is no signal on the phone.

console.sms_err_generic.back: The phone could not send it.

console.sms_err_number.back: Check the number and try again.

console.sms_err_sim_not_found.back: The selected SIM card is not in the phone.

console.f_keep_h.back: The calls, recordings, SMS, AI errands and to-dos older than this are deleted automatically.

console.f_phone_wifi.back: The phones may also connect over Wi-Fi

console.f_phone_wifi_h.back: On: the phone once connected via USB keeps working over Wi-Fi after being pulled out. Off: the phones connect only over USB.

console.f_repair_h.back: Use it when a phone has been lost or somebody else used it.

console.repair_b.back: The phones on Wi-Fi disconnect. Connect each of them again once via USB.

console.repair_done.back: The phones have been paired again. Connect every Wi-Fi phone once via USB.

console.g_backup_d.back: The backup files contain the keys and passwords. Keep them in a place where only you have access to them.

console.bk_dir_h.back: Leave it empty for the default place, or enter the full path of a folder.

console.bk_calls.back: Saving the call logs, recordings and SMS

console.bk_calls_h.back: The backup files will be much bigger.

console.bk_files_empty.back: There is no backup file yet.

console.bk_st_fail.back: The last backup was not successful ({time}). {why}

console.bk_item_numbers.back: Own number notes and fraud numbers

console.bk_warn_plain_settings_file.back: This is a simple settings file, so only the settings are restored.

console.bk_warn_password.back: The password of the web console changes to the one in the backup.

console.bk_dlg_note.back: Before restoring, Bageo saves the current settings into a separate file.

console.bk_done_apply.back: Restored. The earlier settings were saved to: {name}.

console.bk_done_restart.back: Open Bageo again so that everything takes effect.

console.err_backup_dir_unwritable.back: It is not possible to save into this folder. Choose another folder and enter its full path.

console.bk_err_busy.back: A backup or restore is already in progress. Try again after it has finished.

console.bk_err_dir_unwritable.back: It is not possible to save into the backup folder. Choose another folder.

console.bk_err_disk_full.back: The disk is full. Free up space, or choose another folder.

console.bk_err_io.back: The backup did not succeed. Try again in a moment.

console.bk_err_not_backup.back: This is not a Bageo backup file. Choose another file.

console.bk_err_damaged.back: This backup file is damaged. Try another one.

console.bk_err_too_new.back: This backup comes from a newer Bageo version. First install the newer version.

console.bk_warn_keys_kept.back: The keys, passwords and connections on this computer remain unchanged.

console.bk_warn_connections.back: The place where notifications go and the circle of those authorized to control Bageo remotely change to what is in the file.

console.bk_err_need_password.back: For the download, open the web console on the computer running Bageo, or set a password for the web console.

console.bk_err_bad_request.back: There is a problem with the file or the request. Select the file again and try again.

console.bk_err_not_found.back: This backup file no longer exists. Refresh the page and choose another.

console.bk_encrypt_h.back: It protects the copies stored on an external drive, in a cloud folder or in a network folder.

console.bk_pw_h.back: If you forget the password, these backups cannot be opened, and Bageo cannot restore them either.

console.bk_exp_enc.back: Encrypting the file with a password

console.err_backup_password_short.back: The backup password must consist of at least 8 characters.

console.err_backup_password_missing.back: Before switching on the encryption, set a backup password.

console.cu_lan.back: Phones and computers on the same Wi-Fi network can open the web console at this address.

console.cu_lan_nopw.back: Devices on the same Wi-Fi can use this address. Before opening it on another device, set a password for the web console.

console.err_password_too_short.back: The password must consist of at least 8 characters.

console.err_too_many_tries.back: Too many wrong passwords. Try again in a minute.

console.bk_del_b.back: After deletion it cannot be restored.

console.bk_del_need_password.back: For the deletion, open the web console on the computer running Bageo, or set a password for the web console.

console.f_wl_mode_h_direct.back: This phone does not pick up; the carrier forwards the call to your number and the AI stays silent. First switch the device to normal phone and dial **67*your number# for forwarding when busy, otherwise callers reach the voice message.

console.f_wl_mode_h_emergency.back: The AI picks up first; if it is urgent, it makes the caller wait and calls you, and after you pick up they can speak directly. If you do not pick up, the AI promises a call back. Without specifying your own number you only receive a notification.
